comment:
The roofs are fixed, thank you; keep everything except the dome above the peristyle. The dome still reads as a stepped cone (a pyramid of rings). Rebuild ONLY the dome shell above the attic band as a round, bell-shaped dome with this exact profile, centred on the drum's axis (radius in blocks, measured from the axis to the outer face, one course per row, bottom to top):
  course 1: 6.5   course 2: 6.5   course 3: 6.4   course 4: 6.1   course 5: 5.7   course 6: 5.1   course 7: 4.3   course 8: 3.3   course 9: 2.0
i.e. near-vertical for the first three courses, then curving in faster and faster, like the top half of an ellipse: a rounded bell, never straight-sided like a cone. Fill each course as a disc (cells whose centre is within that radius), hollow inside, white (white concrete or smooth quartz); soften each course's outer edge with upside-down or upright quartz stairs facing outward so the profile reads curved, and run 8-12 thin light-grey ribs (light gray concrete or polished diorite, one block wide) up the shell from the base to the top. On course 9 set the lantern (tholos): a small round ring of quartz pillars about 3 across and 3 high with a tiny cap, then the dark bronze Statue of Freedom on top as now. The peristyle drum, the attic and everything below stay exactly as they are.
summary:
Rebuilt only the dome above the attic (parts/dome-upper.mjs): 9 courses y26..34 with radii 6.5, 6.5, 6.4, 6.1, 5.7, 5.1, 4.3, 3.3, 2.0, a hollow 2-thick white shell with quartz stairs and slabs on every stepped edge and 12 thin polished_diorite ribs from base to crown.
On course 9: a lantern of quartz pillars y35..37 round a glowstone core, a stair-ringed cap at y38..39, then the bronze Statue of Freedom at y40..42 as before.
Regenerated with make.sh; a diff against v2.nbt shows only dome cells changed. Check: 0 floating, 0 orphans. Renders from all four sides show a rounded bell.
applied: Exact radius profile: each course filled as a disc of cells whose centre is within the radius, centred on the drum's axis (x 20, z 48), courses y26..34. Three nearly vertical courses, then curving in faster and faster.
Hollow inside: a 2-thick smooth_quartz skin, each course's hollow roofed by the next, course 9 solid. Glowstone on the hollow's floor so nothing spawns inside.

Softened edges: every cell where the next course steps in is an upright smooth_quartz_stairs with its lip facing out (outer-corner stairs on the diagonals, a bottom slab outside it where the step is 2 cells), so the profile reads curved.
12 thin one-block polished_diorite ribs (stairs and slabs where they step) run up from the base course to the crown.

Lantern on course 9: 4 quartz_pillar columns on every other cell of the d4 ring, 3 high (y35..37), round a glowstone core that shows through the gaps. The tiny cap is a ring of upside-down quartz stairs (lip out) at y38 with a 2x2 top at y39.
Statue of Freedom unchanged: polished_diorite pedestal y40, polished_blackstone y41, polished_blackstone_wall y42.
Drum, attic and everything below untouched: the diff against v2.nbt shows changes only in the box 14,26,42 to 25,37,53.
skipped: Lantern 'about 3 across' is 4 across: the dome's centre line falls between blocks, so every round course has an even width. A 2.0 radius gives the 4-wide disc, the nearest fit.
Kept the existing tier of 12 small windows (you didn't mention them; they are on the required-elements list). They moved to course 3 (y28) so they sit on the nearly vertical part of the shell.
Palette flags (glowstone outlier, light-on-light trim) are on the rest of the building, which existed before this change, so I left them alone as you asked.
